spec.description: Overview bounded context restaurants: health, runtime, зависимости и бизнес-поток. Сгенерировано ops/grafana; правки — через генератор.

spec.title: Request rate by entry
spec.description:
Входящая работа по типу входа: gRPC, GraphQL/HTTP, обработка Kafka, Temporal Activities.

Часть запросов ждёт метрик: nomnom_messaging_process_duration_seconds (см. docs/observability/metric-inventory.md).

spec.expr: sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Latency ≤ 0.5s: SLI / SLO 95%
spec.description: Доля хороших событий в шаге графика против цели 95% за 30d (ADR 40).

spec.expr: 1 - (1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.5"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))
vector(0.95)

spec.title: Latency ≤ 0.5s: error budget remaining (30d)
spec.description: Неизрасходованная доля бюджета 0.05 за скользящие 30d. Ниже нуля — SLO нарушен.

spec.expr: 1 - (1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.5"}[30d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[30d])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[30d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[30d]))) / 0.05

spec.title: Latency ≤ 0.5s: burn rate
spec.description: Скорость расхода бюджета: 1 — бюджет кончится ровно за 30d. Пороги: 14.4 за 1h (critical), 6 за 6h (warning), 1 за 3d.

spec.expr: (1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.5"}[1h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[1h])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[1h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[1h]))) / 0.05

(1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.5"}[6h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[6h])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[6h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[6h]))) / 0.05

(1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.5"}[3d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[3d])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[3d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[3d]))) / 0.05

spec.title: Ready pods
spec.description: Разрыв ready и pods — pod не проходит readinessProbe и выведен из Service.

spec.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_ready{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-restaurants", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", condition="true"})
count(kube_pod_status_ready{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-restaurants", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", condition="true"})

spec.description: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff и т. п.: контейнер не запущен.

spec.description:
Transport/availability (CANCELLED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, UNAVAILABLE), application (UNKNOWN, UNIMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL, DATA_LOSS) и business rejection (INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, ALREADY_EXISTS, PERMISSION_DENIED, FAILED_PRECONDITION, ABORTED, OUT_OF_RANGE, UNAUTHENTICATED). Бизнес-результаты в OK-ответе (PaymentDeclined) ошибками не являются.

Часть запросов ждёт метрик: nomnom_messaging_poison_messages_total, nomnom_messaging_process_duration_seconds (см. docs/observability/metric-inventory.md).

spec.expr: sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"INVALID_ARGUMENT|NOT_FOUND|ALREADY_EXISTS|PERMISSION_DENIED|FAILED_PRECONDITION|ABORTED|OUT_OF_RANGE|UNAUTHENTICATED"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.description: Метрики: `container_memory_working_set_bytes`.

spec.description: Метрики: `db_client_operation_duration_seconds`.

spec.expr: sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}) / sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.expr: sum(rate(debezium_metrics_TotalNumberOfEventsSeen{job="infra/kafka-connect", name="restaurants-outbox"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
spec.description: Server-side latency из histograms входа.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))

spec.description: Метрики: `nomnom_fsm_transitions_total`.

spec.description: Метрики: `nomnom_fsm_transitions_total`.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: Используемые CPU-ядра процесса (rate process.cpu.time).

spec.expr: sum by (job) (rate(process_cpu_time_seconds_total{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Kitchen flow
spec.description: Потоки заказов кухни между состояниями за выбранный диапазон: толщина — их число. Панель плагина `volkovlabs-echarts-panel`: без него в stack Grafana покажет, что плагина нет. Счётчики за диапазон: объект, созданный до него, может дойти до этапа внутри него, а объект в работе ещё не дошёл, но и не потерян. Смотреть на диапазоне заметно длиннее обычного заказа.

spec.expr: sum by (nomnom_fsm_from_state, nomnom_fsm_to_state) ((max_over_time(nomnom_fsm_transitions_total{job=~"nomnom/(restaurants|restaurants-consumer)", nomnom_fsm_aggregate_type="restaurant_order", nomnom_fsm_result="applied", nomnom_fsm_trigger!~"report_delay"}[$__range]) - (nomnom_fsm_transitions_total{job=~"nomnom/(restaurants|restaurants-consumer)", nomnom_fsm_aggregate_type="restaurant_order", nomnom_fsm_result="applied", nomnom_fsm_trigger!~"report_delay"} offset $__range or 0 * max_over_time(nomnom_fsm_transitions_total{job=~"nomnom/(restaurants|restaurants-consumer)", nomnom_fsm_aggregate_type="restaurant_order", nomnom_fsm_result="applied", nomnom_fsm_trigger!~"report_delay"}[$__range]))) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(restaurants|restaurants-consumer)", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[$__range])) > 0

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Память процесса.

spec.expr: sum by (job) (process_memory_usage_bytes{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"} and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.expr: (sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[1h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[1h])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[1h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[1h]))) / 0.005

(sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[6h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[6h])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[6h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[6h]))) / 0.005

(sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[3d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[3d])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[3d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[3d]))) / 0.005
